title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good work! We sure got a lot of practice done, huh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You played well. You even nailed the parts that gave you trouble yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's thanks to the advice everyone gave us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This song should be done on-schedule if we keep up at this pace.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'll feel good to wrap it up cleanly before we move on to prep work, won't it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Prep work? For what?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Pay attention, will you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami's birthday is coming up, remember?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right. And she said she wanted to do a show with everyone for her birthday present.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We discussed the setlist just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Happy birthday, Hona♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, wait! It's not her birthday yet!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh!
Oh, right! Forget I said that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We need to plan what else we're doing to celebrate, too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, of course, we'll get a bunch of her favorite foods.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, the apple pie from that shop you mentioned is your new favorite lately, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Look forward to our show, too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If there's anything you'd like us to perform, please let us know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And... Hmm, what else?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What kind of festivities would make you happiest, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I really don't need anything this elaborate.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm just happy you're all celebrating with me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm. So, no apple pie needed, then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh?!
U-Um, well... I would like some...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha, you're always so honest, Hona!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I recall, you said you were going out for your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh, that's nice! Going out someplace for your birthday would be so awesome! Where are you going?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A place called Bow-Wow Wonder Bark Park.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounds like there'll be a lot of dogs there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think so, yes. It's a theme park specially made for dogs and the people who love them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They have huge dog runs, restaurants that you can go in with your dog, and all sorts of other stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's pretty highly rated among dog owners, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I know Hanasato has wanted to go for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, since Honami's birthday is coming up, we figured it would be a great excuse to all go together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like Shibao will have a good time, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I showed him a video of the park, and he seemed excited.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like it will be a fun day.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shibao...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What's wrong, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, uh, I was just thinking I haven't gotten to see him lately...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha! You really want to hang out with Bashi, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, I'll make sure to take lots of photos and videos of Shibao, just for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'm looking forward to it.
Honami's birthday
Bow-Wow Wonder Bark Park

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aah! Samo! Wait for me! Settle down!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hahaha♪
He's running all over the place!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: With all this space to run around in, I can understand how he feels.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a pretty area, too. Just perfect for a good run.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shibao seems a bit restless, himself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There sure are a lot of people here.
And so many different kinds of dogs.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, is that a Yorkshire terrier over there? What a cutie pie!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that looks like a golden retriever. That's a big dog...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They all look like they're having so much fun. It is a bit of a long trip, but I'm glad it's just as nice a place as it looked online.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Samooo!
Sit! Sit, boy!
Oh no, he's not listening at all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hey, everyone! I don't think Samo can wait any longer, so can we go to the dog run?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe, that sounds good.
You want to go too, don't you, Shibao?

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof!
